## Projects

### StudentMind
- **URL**: https://studentmind-v1.vercel.app/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Yash-1505/studentmind-v1
- **Description**: Multi-provider AI study companion integrating 6 LLM providers (Gemini, Groq, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Cohere) with zero backend dependency — API keys stay client-side. Five study modes (Summary, Cheat Sheet, Learning Path, Quiz, Resource Finder), PDF/DOCX upload, voice input, localStorage session manager with 30+ saved conversations, one-click PDF/DOCX/Markdown export, 16-language support via Sarvam and Google Translate APIs, GitHub Actions CI/CD, BUSL 1.1 licence.
- **Stack**: TypeScript, React 19, Vite, Tailwind v4, Gemini API, Groq, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Cohere, Sarvam AI

### NotebookLM Prompt Vault
- **URL**: https://notebooklm-prompt-vault.vercel.app/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Yash-1505/notebooklm-prompt-vault
- **Description**: Multi-page, batch-aware prompt library for Parul University students — organises 2,700+ lines of curriculum data across 7+ academic programs using vanilla JavaScript ES modules with a barrel-import pattern (curricula/index.js) for dynamic per-subject prompt generation. Cross-tab state sync via Storage API, persistent theming via localStorage, custom security headers, dual-hosted on Vercel + Netlify, 4+ shipped bug fixes (state persistence, cross-tab desync, race conditions).
- **Stack**: JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Prompt Engineering, Vercel, Netlify
